topicName: What is the purpose of the @RestController annotation?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is the purpose of the @RestController annotation?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The @RestController annotation in Spring Boot simplifies the creation of RESTful controllers. It's a convenience annotation that combines @Controller and @ResponseBody, eliminating the need to annotate every request handling method with @ResponseBody. This makes it easier to build APIs that return data directly in formats like JSON or XML."}]
